entries.claim_boundary: This exact LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC/REDUCED-MODE result separates a vanishing compact stabilizer Kuranishi class from nonzero bounded resonant shell obstructions at third order for one balanced fixture. It certifies a smooth secular third-order preimage abstractly, not a bounded, causal, all-orders, particle, positivity, unitarity or quantum result.

dispersion.statement: The sixteen-point third-order frequency lattice and its four original-shell coincidences are exact.

lee_wald.statement: The shell adjoints use the action-normalized reduced axial Hessian and its certified Lee-Wald pairing.

resonance.statement: Local-in-time shell resonance is a separate cokernel and correction-class question.

bounded_or_finite_quasiperiodic.statement: The declared balanced tangent has the imported finite second-order correction.

causal_retarded.statement: No retarded compact-product correction complex is supplied.

smooth_secular.statement: The same second-order correction is smooth and finite quasiperiodic.

taub_maps.statement: K3=0 in O/im(l2), with im(l2)=span{H,J1,J2} and quotient basis {P_x,J3}.
